chatParticipants.name: schemer
chatParticipants.description: Ask Schemer to explain your SQL file - grounded only in your files, never a live database.

sqlFileExplainer.provider.description: Choose the LLM provider for SQL file explanations: a local Ollama instance, or a cloud model using your own API key.

sqlFileExplainer.cloudProviderKind.description: Which cloud provider to use when "provider" is set to "cloud".

sqlFileExplainer.embeddingProvider.description: Embedding method for local retrieval. "hashing" needs no extra install. "transformers-js" gives richer semantic search but requires running: npm install @xenova/transformers.

sqlFileExplainer.schemaFolderPath.description: Relative path to the folder containing SQL files (for example: schema or schema/migration).

sqlFileExplainer.cloudApiKey.description: Stored securely in SecretStorage. Do not edit this value in settings.json.
